description: Convert an Excel spreadsheet to PDF in your browser, with its dates, totals and column widths intact. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The Excel workbook (.xlsx or .xlsm), base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped if present. The old binary .xls format is refused with error 'xls'. Up to 25 MB once decoded.

gridlines.description: Draw the cell grid as Excel shows it on screen. A sheet whose author turned gridlines off stays without them. Defaults to true.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for decimal and thousands separators and month names, e.g. de-DE shows 1.234,50. Excel draws these from the reader's computer, not the file. Defaults to en-US.

pageSize.description: document uses the paper size each sheet's page setup names (A4 when it names none). a4 or letter overrides it for every sheet. Orientation is chosen per sheet either way. Defaults to document.

sheets.description: Names of the sheets (tabs) to include, in workbook order. Leave out to include every visible sheet; naming a hidden sheet includes it.

name: excel_to_pdf
title: Excel to PDF
